mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 49 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. We are currently under a new moon phase, and later tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 45 degrees with rain in the forecast.

In city news, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is currently underway. Contractors are wrapping up concrete work for curbs, sidewalks, and driveways, with asphalt work currently in progress. Please check the city website for more detailed project schedules.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, you can participate in trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, the Verona Police Department arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence after he was found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
